message: Hi, my kid Oli is 9 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for ages 8-10, so Oli would be a perfect fit.
Classes run Monday through Friday afternoons and Saturday mornings. Would you like to book a free trial class for him?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class! What time do you have available?
Awesome! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.lagoon@gmail.com.
Perfect! And can I grab your phone number? Just so we can reach you if anything comes up with the class.
Got it, thanks! And what's Oli's full name?
Oli's full name is Oliver Lagoon.
Perfect! Last thing - what's Oliver's date of birth?

Great! Oliver is 9, so he's perfect for our Kids 8-10 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. I have these times available for his free trial:

- Monday, July 13 at 3:30 PM
- Wednesday, July 8 at 3:30 PM
- Wednesday, July 15 at 3:30 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Monday, July 13 at 3:30 PM.
Perfect! Oliver is all set for Monday, July 13 at 3:30 PM. Ill send the details to tester.lagoon@gmail.com. No equipment needed, just come ready to have fun! See you both then.
